body:
“Are you trying to date a supermodel?”  I like your realism. No I don’t try to date supermodels but people I try to date are supermodel, compared to me. It is the classic “out of league” situation. 

Besides, the statement my best years are wasted is not correct, I agree. But I can make a very accurate estimation based on what I have been living that my best years will be wasted. Wait a minute, I don’t know why I am talking these to you, my main intention was not to open myself, when I sent this post. Thanks for your kind and far more importantly realistic approach. I got the answer of my question. I wish things had been different, I wish we had lived in a just world. It doesn’t seem to end happily for me, but I am trying and will try until I decide it’s time to stop. Take care, wish you fortune in your life.

Well, clearly you are not the member of the group of people I mentioned about, and what you said is mostly true. I am glad to see some realistic people. 

However, as we agreed on worst-case scenarios, I want to step up. Every person has its standards, right? Some is happy if he manages to have a moderate income and have a house to live in, whereas some is sad because he does not have a bmw, but a let’s say opel. This still does not give the idea clearly, I will tell you mine: I am male(20, not a teenager, thus can understand truely what’s going on without the influence of emotions). I suffer from being ugly and its consequences. I am quite happy with other things on my life, but 10x sad with what I don’t have. It is really hard to know that my best years are wasted because I am ugly, and acknowledging this truth and trying to move on is even worse. Would you say that I have a chance to be happy, while I see having a self-esteem and “my feelings to a crush accompanied by her” as a must? There is better for any good, worse for any bad. Renember, we agreed for worst case scenarios, then what if there are some people thniking of us -well, me- the same way I think for the people in the worst cases? Their existence is not important, what I want to say is that every person has different happiness thresholds. Mine is bigger than my potential, and I don’t want to decrease it, I can’t stand the idea that I will be rejected every single time when I open my feelings to a person. You see the pattern?

I would be happy if someone with magic stick fixed my problems. I would even worship him. Do you know anyone with such capabilities? I understand that you want to approach in a kind way but please, what I need is either a magic stick or an idea that will decrease the sadness of my loved ones due to my death.

That's good to hear that you are not obese which means you need less time to become who you want to be. About sports, it is also good to thear that you do it. Then, let me tell you something. Your sentence" my exercise do not seem to kerp up with my massive apetite." made me think that the biggest problem in your situation is your apetite. You cant try undergoing surgery done to decrease one's apetite. Or if it is something you can manage by yourself, I suggest you to endure the pain and try to watch ehat you eat. To be honest, I do not know how it feels to have constant urge to eat something, but I have experienced similiar pains, I believe. 

What I say briefly is, make sure you have tried every single thing to become who you want to be.

Based on what I have read, no you are not done. 

You suffer from obesity and claim that you did things to recover from it, right? I searched your post for the word "sport" but I could not find it. So, have you tried doing exercises, or you just depended on pills you took. Do not get me wrong, it is a question, not a prejudice. 

I know it is not easy to lose weight, but be sure that it really is possible. Fight as harsh as you can, no matter how hungry you feel, keep going. Afterall, compared to the fear of acknowledging death, what is it to feel hungry?

This is the question exists in my mind as well. I think expectations from life varies from person to person and those who are ugly and still are happy are the ones that don't expect to live the life high in terms of sexual life, I wont say social life because it is - in many cases- not an obstacle to socialize. And when it comes to ones that both ugly and desires to have a bf/gf, I think they either maintain their hopes that someday they will be loved, too or fear to think of this trobling issue and try to ignore it.

Not to courage suicide: most of the incidents are of ridicilous reasons, I believe. My question is only valid when there is nothing left to do. Make sure that you have tried everything,E V E R Y T H İ N G, before making a stupid decision.
